About.title: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation
About.description: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation is a completely non-political and non-profit service organization dedicated to education, dawah, spiritual purification, and humanitarian welfare. Following the noble example of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the organization works for humanitarian service, promotion of Islamic civilization, social reform, employment creation, poverty alleviation, relief distribution, educational projects, affordable or free healthcare, moral development, and calling people toward guidance through modern communication platforms.
About.missionText: The mission and objective of SHEF is to establish a welfare-based society through education, dawah, spiritual purification, and service-oriented activities in light of the noble life example of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
About.activitySubtitle: Sabilul Huda Education Foundation-SHEF primarily works in four sectors.
policies: SHEF is a completely non-political and non-profit service organization. Its activities have no connection with politics.
The organization serves people regardless of party, opinion, religion, or ethnicity.
The core areas of work are education and training, dawah and research, tazkiyah and self-purification, and humanitarian service.
The organization avoids disputes, conflicts, and divisions among communities and groups.
In Shariah matters, SHEF follows the widely accepted principles of Ahlus Sunnah wal Jama’ah.
SHEF maintains balanced relations with all Islamic organizations and communities without taking sides in conflicts.
The organization works to develop dialogue, humanity, generosity, brotherhood, and unity among different communities.
incomeSources: One-time and regular donations from members, supporters, and well-wishers.
Donations given by the public for specific causes.
Zakat, Fitrah, Sadaqah, and general donations.
Funds collected for Ramadan, Iftar, Qurbani, and special causes.
Government or non-government grants and financial support.
5-10% administrative cost deducted from relevant projects.
expensePolicies: Donations are spent only in the cause specified by the donor.
Funds from one category are not spent in another category.
100% of Zakat funds are distributed among eligible recipients.
Detailed income and expense records are preserved after every project.
All income and expenses of SHEF are audited by a chartered accountant.

achievements.title: Education
achievements.description: Under the supervision of SHEF, two separate madrasahs for boys and girls have been established in Kushtia. The organization has also initiated Islamic schools based on an integrated curriculum of general and Islamic education.

achievements.title: Dawah
achievements.description: SHEF continues online and offline dawah activities among Bangla-speaking people. The organization also distributes books and leaflets related to dawah and tabligh.

achievements.title: Research
achievements.description: The chairman of SHEF, Shaykh Dr. Shahidul Islam Faruqi, has authored several research works on important contemporary Islamic topics.

achievements.title: Iftar & Ramadan Food Distribution
achievements.description: Every Ramadan, thousands of fasting people receive Iftar and food packs. So far, hundreds of thousands of fasting and needy people have benefited from SHEF.

achievements.title: Qurbani
achievements.description: Every year during Qurbani, SHEF distributes sacrificial animals and meat among poor and helpless people. Nearly 1,000 cows/goats have been distributed so far.

achievements.title: Winter Clothing Distribution
achievements.description: Every winter, SHEF distributes winter clothing in cold-prone areas. More than 20,000 winter clothing items have been distributed.

achievements.title: Rohingya Support
achievements.description: SHEF has provided free medical camps, temporary shelters, tube wells, toilets, solar systems, and other support for Rohingya communities.

achievements.title: Tube Well Installation
achievements.description: Under the Water for Life project, SHEF has installed more than 300 tube wells in remote areas of the country.

achievements.title: Food Distribution
achievements.description: Food distribution among poverty-stricken people is one of SHEF’s ongoing projects. Since 2023, 1,000 needy families receive food baskets every year.

achievements.title: Relief Distribution
achievements.description: Since its establishment, SHEF has been conducting relief activities in flood-affected districts.

achievements.title: Widow Support
achievements.description: SHEF supports widows with cash, clothing, and income-generating resources. Many widows have received sewing machines.

achievements.title: Orphan Care
achievements.description: SHEF takes responsibility for the education and care of orphan students in its managed madrasahs.

achievements.title: COVID-19 Support
achievements.description: During the COVID-19 period, thousands of helpless and needy people benefited from SHEF’s support.

achievements.title: Healthcare
achievements.description: SHEF regularly organizes free medical camps in different areas and provides financial assistance for poor and helpless patients.

EducationTraining.title: Education and Training Activities
EducationTraining.subtitle: Empowering communities through Islamic education, modern learning, and life-oriented development initiatives.
EducationTraining.activity1: Preparation of modern Islamic curriculum and textbooks.
EducationTraining.activity2: Establishment of ‘Sabahi Maktab’ to spread basic education at pre-primary level.
EducationTraining.activity3: Conducting ‘After School Maktab’ activities to protect the faith of school-going children.
EducationTraining.activity4: Establishment of schools/madrasahs with integrated syllabus of Islamic and general education.
EducationTraining.activity5: Establishment of schools, colleges, universities and technical schools in religious environment.
EducationTraining.activity6: Take proper measures for children, elderly, disabled and women education.
EducationTraining.activity7: Competition on education, culture and life-oriented issues.

DawahResearch.title: Dawah & Research
DawahResearch.subtitle: Promoting authentic Islamic knowledge, research, and dawah activities for the betterment of the Ummah.
DawahResearch.activity1: Construction of ‘Sabilul Huda Mosque Complex and Islamic Centre’ as a center for conducting multipurpose Dawah activities.
DawahResearch.activity2: To develop up-to-date Islamic scholars and daees to meet the contemporary needs of the Muslim Ummah.
DawahResearch.activity3: Organizing religious mahfils, seminars, symposiums, exchange of views and discussions.
DawahResearch.activity4: Publication and dissemination of original, translated and research books on Islam.
DawahResearch.activity5: To take various initiatives to eradicate shirk-bid’ah, marginalization and extremism.
DawahResearch.activity6: Live and video discussions based on social media.

Tazkiyah.title: Tazkiyah & Self-Purification
Tazkiyah.subtitle: Building moral character, spiritual purification, and social reform based on authentic Islamic teachings.
Tazkiyah.activity1: Conducting self-purification activities free from shirk and bid’ah in the methods of Prophet (SWA).
Tazkiyah.activity2: Publication and dissemination of books on character correction and social reform.
Tazkiyah.activity3: To take various initiatives to protect people from shirk, bid’ah and superstition.
Tazkiyah.activity4: Islah-e-Muasharah or taking various initiatives for social reform.
Tazkiyah.activity5: Organizing ‘Majlisut Tazkiyah’ or Majlis of Self-Purification.

ServiceHumanity.title: Service of Humanity
ServiceHumanity.subtitle: Extending compassionate humanitarian support and welfare services to underprivileged and vulnerable communities.
ServiceHumanity.activity1: To provide various types of training and financial assistance for unemployment and poverty alleviation.
ServiceHumanity.activity2: Providing relief assistance in areas affected by natural disasters.
ServiceHumanity.activity3: Distribution of iftar items and Ramadan food among the needy during the month of Ramadan.
ServiceHumanity.activity4: Distribution of Fitra, clothes and Eid items among the destitute on the occasion of Eid.
ServiceHumanity.activity5: Distribution of sacrificial animals and meat among the poor.
ServiceHumanity.activity6: Distribution of earning materials like rickshaws, sewing machines etc. among the destitute.
ServiceHumanity.activity7: Providing free or low-cost medical care to the needy.
ServiceHumanity.activity8: Installation of tubewells and reservoirs for the underprivileged for drinking water.
ServiceHumanity.activity9: Rehabilitation of orphans, disabled, widows, neo-Muslims and street children.
ServiceHumanity.activity10: Tree plantation and care for self-reliance and environmental protection.
